metadata.title: Topology of tame contractible $n$-manifolds, $n=6,7$, and BiRicci Curvature
metadata.abstract: We show that if $M^n$, $n=6,7$, is the interior of a compact, contractible $n$-manifold with boundary $X$, such that $\pi_i(X,\partial X)=0$, $3\leq i \leq n-3$, and supports complete metrics with positive BiRicci curvature with $C$-quadratic decay at infinity for some $C>\frac{n^2}{4}$, then $M$ is diffeomorphic to $\mathbb{R}^n$. Furthermore, we construct a compact, contractible Newman $n$-manifold $N^n$, $n\geq6$, based on a presentation of the Higman group such that $\pi_i(N,\partial N)=0$, $3\leq i \leq n-3$, and $\mathrm{int}(N)$ admits a metric with uniform positive scalar curvature.

analysis.progressType: BiRicci 衰减下 tame contractible 流形的标准性
analysis.workSummary: 对 n=6,7 的 compact contractible interior，在指定相对同伦消失与 C>n²/4 的正 BiRicci 二次衰减下证明微分同胚 Rⁿ；另构造 n≥6、uniform positive scalar 的 Newman 流形。
analysis.breakthrough: 区分强 BiRicci 拓扑刚性与正标量曲率的非标准例子。
analysis.limitations: 维数、相对同伦及衰减常数不可删；正标量曲率构造不提供相同 BiRicci 假设。
analysis.priorityReason: 区分强 BiRicci 拓扑刚性与正标量曲率的非标准例子。
